title: Finally! Most requested Brown butter chocolate chip cookies! 🤎🍪  #fyp...
description: Finally! Most requested Brown butter chocolate chip cookies! 🤎🍪  #fyp #foodie  #baking  #bakedwithlove #recipe #yum
transcript: Finally, na-achieve ko rin yung perfect na brown butter chocolate chip cookies na gusto ko. Di ko rin and expect na ganito lang pala siya kadaling gawin, kaya ituturo ko rin sa inyo. So first, i-brown yung muna yung butter and then ilagay nyo yung 1 cup of sugar. Next naman is yung 1 whole egg and 1 egg yolk. Nagailin kayo ng 1.5 tsp of vanilla and 2 cups of all-purpose flour and 1 tsp of baking soda and 1 cup of chocolate bar. You can also use chocolate chips pero make sure na ang gagamitin nyo is yung unsweetened. Then after that, mag-form kayo ng circle, i-roll nyo lang sa hands nyo and then, pwede nyo nang ilagay sa container. Make sure na may takip yung container nyo kasi kailangan nakasil talaga yan bago natin ilagay sa freezer. After niyang mag-overnight sa freezer, pwede na natin tung i-bake in 190 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes. As you can see, right after ko siyang ilabas sa ref, dinirek ko na siya dito sa oven. And after 15 minutes nilabas ko na agad sa oven to cool down. Grabe, di look so perfect. Ngayon ko lang na-achieve yung ganitoong cookies. Medyo ma-init pa pero excited na akong tikman kaya nagtis-test na ako agad. Super worth it going to. Sobrang bilis lang din kaya itry nyo na rin.
